text: Starting with just paneer in 1998, Milky Mist became an Indian dairy powerhouse.
Now, their highly anticipated IPO is finally open and making massive market waves.
Open until August thirteenth, this massive public issue aims to raise 1,553 crores.
The share price is capped at 140 rupees, requiring 15,000 for one lot.
They dominate with high-margin products like thick curd, cheese, and premium ghee.
The fresh capital will clear company debt and expand their modern manufacturing factory.
